title: Return 404 for a missing order
summary: A Minimal API handler answers 200 with null. Return Results.NotFound, then put the 404 in the type with TypedResults.

turns.user: hitting a missing id still gives me 200. body is just null

assistant.body: Got it. The handler returns the Order? as is, so a null is serialized to JSON with 200 OK. Returning Results.NotFound when nothing is found is the best practice here.

app.MapGet("/orders/{id:int}", async (int id, IOrderRepository orders) =>
    await orders.FindAsync(id) is { } order
        ? Results.Ok(order)
        : Results.NotFound());

turns.user: openapi only lists 200. want the 404 in there too

assistant.body: Let's put both outcomes in the return type. With TypedResults and Results<Ok<Order>, NotFound>, the 404 shows up in the document automatically.
